full_judgment: 2. The petitioner, one of the defendants in Other Suit No. 107 of 1992 subsequently re-numbered as Other Suit No. 71 of 1997 now pending before the 2nd Court of Subordinate Judge, Rajshahi, filed this application under section 115 (1) of the Code of Civil Procedure. His case, in short, is that, the opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 as plaintiffs instituted the aforesaid Other Suit No. 107 of 1992 renumbered as Other Suit Suit No. 71 of 1997 for declaration of title with recovery of Khas possession against the petitioner who is the defendant No. 1 in the said suit and others. The case of the plaintiff opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 is, in short, that, the suit property belongs to their predecessors and the plaintiffs opposite parties 1 to 3 were in peaceful possession of the same and the same has been recorded correctly in their names in SA Khatian and RS Khatian measuring 2562 decimals in SA dag No. 240 and RS Dag No. 461. Their names were recorded correctly in the SA Khatian and they were owning and possessing the same as their ejmali properties. But this defendant petitioner is trespasser in the suit land who took possession of the same on 10-6-92 in absence of the plaintiffs. This has resulted in filing the Other Suit No. 107 of 1992 with a prayer for declaration of title with recovery of khas possession.
